# Javed Ahmed — AI & Custom Software for Small Businesses

> Javed Ahmed is a freelance AI and custom software developer. He builds AI receptionists that answer business calls 24/7, AI chatbots, and custom booking, scheduling and CRM systems for small businesses in the United States and Europe, and hosts and maintains them after launch.

## Services
- AI receptionist: answers calls 24/7, books appointments, summarises every call, transfers urgent calls
- Website and store chatbots trained on a business's own products and policies
- Booking and scheduling systems connected to staff plans, with no double bookings
- Custom CRMs and dashboards
- Shopify stores, themes and automation
- Hosting, monitoring and maintenance on AWS or the client's server

## Selected work
- Join Intake: AI receptionist platform with call log, AI summaries and appointment booking
- PharmaDienst: shift planning, absences, timesheets and online booking for pharmacies in Germany
- Real estate investor portal: projects, funding, documents and role-based investor access
- CyberBike: custom e-commerce admin for a US e-bike brand with an AI chat assistant
- Copier1: Shopify store for a US copier dealer with model search and quote requests
- Cutting Edge Decking: website, custom CMS, 3D project models and analytics for a steel deck manufacturer
- Steel deck takeoff tool: AI estimating app that reads PDF drawings and calculates deck order quantities
